briefing: NASDAQ +1.6% and S&P 500 +1.1% mark a clear risk-on session, so with 3 open slots and cash above the $500 threshold we deployed into two of the highest-scoring, fully-confirmed candidates rather than sitting idle. AAL and BFLY both show all four bullish signals (RSI in the healthy 55-70 zone, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20), and we kept one slot plus some cash in reserve rather than force a third buy.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means only acting on a bullish signal when multiple independent indicators agree — here, RSI in a healthy range, a MACD bullish crossover, a rising MACD histogram, and price above its 20-day average all lining up together. Relying on just one signal (like RSI alone) is more likely to be noise; four aligned signals suggest real, broad-based buying interest.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認指的是只有在多項獨立技術指標同時發出看漲訊號時才進場，例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、MACD柱狀圖持續放大，以及股價站上20日均線。若只依賴單一訊號（如RSI），容易誤判雜訊；四項訊號同時出現則代表真正、廣泛的買盤力道。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices rallied today with the NASDAQ up 1.6% and the S&P 500 up 1.1%, a pattern consistent with renewed risk appetite across growth and cyclical names alike. The breadth of the move — strength in airlines, semiconductors, and speculative small-caps together — suggests investors were rotating back into risk assets rather than reacting to a single catalyst. No specific news headlines were available in today's data feed to cite directly.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤普遍上揚，納斯達克指數上漲1.6%，標普500指數上漲1.1%，顯示市場風險偏好明顯回升。從航空股、半導體到投機性小型股同步走強來看，資金似乎是全面重新流入風險資產，而非受單一消息面事件驅動。今日數據中未提供具體新聞標題可供引用。

trades.reasoning: RSI 55.1 (least overbought of the top-scored names), bullish MACD crossover, rising histogram, and price above SMA-20 all confirm institutional buying on a risk-on day.
Full four-signal confirmation (RSI 63.3, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20) plus a different sector (medtech) diversifies the tech-heavy current book.
